annotations.pd_harm_distress: My stomach turns at the thought of my hand on that lever.
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: figuring the train is on the other line
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: Nothing has told them anyone would redirect it toward them.
annotations.pda_responsibility: Pulling it would mean I actively chose to make things worse

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The lone worker likely knows by now he can't get clear.
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: It's a grim thought and I'm not comfortable with it
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: swap that for a track with more people on it

annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: picked where to stand based on the schedule they were given
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I keep going back and forth

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: he's hoping someone does something, anything
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: He can see it coming and has no way out, so of course he'd want rescue
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I hate that his hope is something I can't answer.
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: I can't give him that by aiming it at five others.

annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: That's the whole point of track safety, and they're counting on it.
annotations.sys_rule_justification: I can't be the person who breaks that, not for any reason
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: It's a sick feeling, being this close and still stuck.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: wouldn't ask me to trade five coworkers for him
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: spent years alongside people like them and knows what they mean
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: Everything about this sits tight in my chest.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: They'd expect the person at the switch to leave it
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: a crew who'd been told their track was clear
annotations.pda_responsibility: at least I wouldn't have been the one steering

annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: because nothing has warned them otherwise
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I'm scared of standing there doing nothing, but I'm more scared

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The five believe they're out of the train's path
annotations.pd_harm_distress: My hands are unsteady just imagining it.

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: it frightens me how final that is
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: they'd only be thinking of him
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: which makes sense since he's their person
